summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Bulk Lead Assignment and Add Ops User features. Fixed critical route ordering bug in crm.py. All 13 backend tests passed, all frontend UI tests passed.

fixed_during_testing.issue: Route ordering bug - /bulk-assign and /operations-team routes were defined AFTER /{lead_id} route, causing FastAPI to match 'bulk-assign' as a lead_id parameter
fixed_during_testing.fix: Moved /bulk-assign and /operations-team routes to be defined BEFORE /{lead_id} routes
fixed_during_testing.impact: Bulk assign API was returning 'No updates provided' instead of working correctly

passed_tests: Add Ops User button visible in Admin nav bar
Add Ops User modal opens with all form fields (Full Name, Email, Password, Phone)
Create new Ops user with valid data - success toast shown
Newly created Ops user can login immediately
Checkboxes visible on each lead in leads list
Bulk assign controls appear when leads selected (count indicator, assignee dropdown, Assign button)
Bulk assign API: PUT /api/crm/bulk-assign works correctly
Create ops user API: POST /api/auth/create-ops-user works correctly
GET /api/crm/operations-team returns list of ops team members
Non-admin cannot create ops users (403 error)
Non-admin cannot bulk assign leads (403 error)
Duplicate email validation on create ops user
critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering in FastAPI is critical - static routes like /bulk-assign must be defined before dynamic routes like /{lead_id}
Minor lint warnings: unused 'result' variables in crm.py (lines 159, 332, 398) - not critical
seed_data_creation: Multiple test ops users created during testing (testops_*, uitest_*)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk Lead Assignment and Add Ops User features are fully working. Admin can select multiple leads via checkboxes and bulk assign them to an Ops team member. Admin can create new Ops users via modal form in the nav bar. The /api/crm/bulk-assign and /api/auth/create-ops-user endpoints are working correctly. Route ordering bug was fixed in crm.py.

features_verified.add_ops_user_modal: PASS - Opens with Full Name, Email, Password, Phone fields
features_verified.create_ops_user_api: PASS - POST /api/auth/create-ops-user creates user with role=operations, is_approved=true
features_verified.new_ops_user_login: PASS - Newly created ops user can login immediately
features_verified.lead_checkboxes: PASS - Checkboxes visible on each lead in leads list
features_verified.bulk_assign_controls: PASS - Count indicator, assignee dropdown, Assign button appear when leads selected
features_verified.bulk_assign_api: PASS - PUT /api/crm/bulk-assign assigns multiple leads to ops team member
features_verified.operations_team_api: PASS - GET /api/crm/operations-team returns list of ops team members

api_endpoints_tested.POST /api/auth/create-ops-user: PASS - Admin only, creates operations user
api_endpoints_tested.PUT /api/crm/bulk-assign: PASS - Admin only, bulk assigns leads
api_endpoints_tested.GET /api/crm/operations-team: PASS - Returns ops team members for dropdown

bug_fixed.root_cause: FastAPI matches routes in order of definition. The /{lead_id} route was defined before /bulk-assign, so 'bulk-assign' was being matched as a lead_id parameter
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Moved /bulk-assign and /operations-team routes to be defined before /{lead_id} routes
bug_fixed.verification: Bulk assign API now returns correct response with assigned_count
